text_block_list.text: Um, why are you asking such a question...?
choice_data_list: Because you let out a sigh.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry for causing you to worry. I'll 
be more careful next time...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Um, I'm feeling perfectly fine. ...I'm 
always ready to run with everything I've 
got.

Even so, fatigue seems to be catching up 
to her. I might need to reconsider Silence 
Suzuka's upcoming race schedule...
